## Change

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands run, real conversion samples and relevant platform/engine versions.

## Limits and risks

Document fidelity changes, memory implications, optional engines and packaging impact.

- [ ] Originals and existing outputs remain protected.
- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] README, formats, project facts and changelog match the change.
- [ ] Current-head CI, engine integration, package validation and CodeQL are green.
